senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (चलति)
To tremble, to shake or totter.
r. 6th cl. (चलति)
To sport, to play, to frolic or wanton.
r. 10th cl. (-चालयति)
To cherish, to foster.
(चालयति, चलयति)
To shake, to cause to shake.
With प्र,
To fall as from a seat.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Trembling, tremulous, unfixed or unsteady.
m. (-लः)
Trembling, shaking.
f. (-ला)
1 The goddess of fortune, LAKṢMĪ.
2 Lightning.
3 Incense.
E.
चल to go, affix अच्, fem. affix टाप्.

m. (-लः)
1 The thatch or roof of a house.
2 The blue jay.
E.
चल to go, affix अण्.

m. (-र्णः)
The true distance of a planet from the earth
E.
चल, and कर्ण hypothenuse.

m. (-ञ्चुः)
The Greek partridge: see चकोर.
E.
चल tremulous, and चञ्चु a beak.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Fickle, inconstant.
n. (-त्तं)
Fickleness, mutability.
E.
चल, and चित्त mind.

f. (-ता)
Fickleness, unsteadiness, inconstancy.
E.
तल् added to the last: also with त्व, चलचित्तत्वं.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
Going, moving.
E.
चल to go, शतृ aff.

n. adv. (-दं)
Moving, walking.
E.
चलत्, and पद a step.

f. (-मा)
A small fish, (Canda, HAM.)
E.
चलत् trembling, and पूर्णिमा full moon, being of a white, glistering colour, like that of the moon.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A fish, a sort of gilt-head.
E.
चलत् trembling, and अङ्ग body; also with कन् added चलदङ्गक.

m. (-लः)
The holy fig tree.
E.
चल shaking, and दल a leaf.

m. (-षः)
The Kokila or cuckoo.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं)
1 Who or what goes or moves.
2 Trembling, tremulous, shaking.
m. (-नः)
1 A foot.
2 A deer, an antelope.
f. (-नी)
1 A short petticoat worn by common women.
2 The tye of an elephant.
n. (-नं)
1 Wandering, roaming.
2 Trembling, shaking.
3 Going.
E.
चल to go, affix ल्युट् or युच्.

nf. (-नं-नी)
A sieve, a strainer.
n. (-नं)
1 Causing to move or go.
2 Muscular action.
E.
चल in the causal, to make go, (grain, &c. through its pores,) ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.

n. (-कं)
A short petticoat worn by women of some rank.
E.
चलन, and कन् added.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Going, moving, proceeding.
E.
चल to go, शानच् aff.

n. (-लः)
Wood sorrel: see अम्ल.
E.
चल to go, असुन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-न्धिः)
Moveable articulation of the bones, Diarthrosis.
E.
चल, and सन्धि a joint.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Tremulous, unsteady, unfixed.
2 Moveable and stationary.
m. (-लः)
A cow.
E.
चल to go, affix अच्, deriv. reiterated, and the first final vowel made long, or चल, and अचल immoveable.

m. (-लिः)
A cover, a wrapper, a surtout: see निचोल.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Shaking, trembling.
2 Gone, departed.
3 Went, proceeded.
E.
चल to go, affix क्त.

m. (-लुः)
A handful of water, water taken up in the hollowed palm of the hand for rincing the mouth, &c.
E.
चल to go, affix उ.

m. (-कः)
1 The hand hollowed as for holding a little water, &c.
2 A small pot, a gallipot, &c.
n. (-कं)
A handful of water: see चलु.
E.
चल to go, उकच affix: see चुलक.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Sensitive, sensual, not having subdued senses or passions.
E.
चल, and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.

m. (-कः)
A restive elephant.
E.
चल to go, ण्वुल् aff.
